sql_query:
WITH sales_by_product AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id AS product_id,
    SUM(1) AS total_sales
  FROM order_items AS oi
  GROUP BY
    oi.product_id
),
reviews_by_product AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id AS product_id,
    AVG(orv.review_score) AS average_review_score
  FROM order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN order_reviews AS orv
    ON orv.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY
    oi.product_id
)
SELECT
  LEFT(p.product_id, 10) AS product_id,
  CAST(p.product_photos_qty AS INTEGER) AS number_of_photos,
  CAST(p.product_description_lenght AS INTEGER) AS description_length_chars,
  rbp.average_review_score AS average_review_score,
  sbp.total_sales AS total_sales
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN sales_by_product AS sbp
  ON sbp.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN reviews_by_product AS rbp
  ON rbp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  COALESCE(p.product_photos_qty, 0) > 0
  OR sbp.product_id IS NOT NULL
  OR rbp.product_id IS NOT NULL;
